idea-plugin.name: Backbeat
idea-plugin.description:
Control Spotify without leaving your editor. Search, skip, queue and like songs from the IDE while the music keeps playing in your Spotify app.

IMPORTANT: read this before you install. Backbeat needs three things to work:

  1. The Spotify desktop app must be open. Backbeat is a remote control, not a music player. It tells your Spotify app what to play, and Spotify makes the sound. Keep the Spotify desktop app running next to your IDE (minimised or in the tray is fine), signed in to the same account. If Spotify is closed, there is nothing to control and nothing will play.
  2. Spotify Premium. Spotify only allows Premium accounts to be controlled from other apps.
  3. Your own free Spotify Client ID. A one-minute, one-time setup. The Backbeat tool window walks you through it step by step.

What you get

  • Player tool window: cover art, play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, repeat, like, volume and device switching.
  • Search Everywhere tab: press Shift twice, open the Spotify tab, type, hit Enter. Shift+Enter adds to the queue.
  • Library and queue: your playlists, Liked Songs, recently played and what is up next.
  • Status bar: the current song. Click for a mini player, middle-click to play or pause, scroll to change the volume.
  • Keyboard shortcuts for every control, all rebindable in Keymap.

Made for coding

  • Pause on breakpoint: silence while you debug, music back when the program continues.
  • Project soundtrack: pin an album or playlist to a project and start it when the project opens.
  • Focus sessions: a Pomodoro timer that plays while you focus and goes quiet for the break.

Privacy: Backbeat talks only to Spotify. Login uses OAuth with PKCE, so your password never reaches the IDE and there is no client secret. Your session token is kept in the IDE password safe. No analytics, no telemetry.

Why your own Client ID? Spotify limits every third-party app in development mode to five users, so a plugin cannot ship a shared one.

Backbeat is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Spotify. Spotify is a trademark of Spotify AB.
